si_4_title: Detecting accelerated retinal decline in mental disorders through normative modeling

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: UK Biobank (N = 56,545 healthy controls and N = 538 patients with schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, or major depression)
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: Using UK Biobank data, we estimated age-related retinal decline in healthy controls (HC, N = 56,545)... we then included N = 538 separate individuals from the UK Biobank with a mental disorder

answer.UK Biobank: normative training for the models; patient comparison for schizophrenia (SZ), bipolar disorder (BD), and major depressive disorder (MDD)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: UK Biobank healthy control data (N=56,545) was used to train normative models for macular thickness, RNFL, and GC-IPL. UK Biobank patient data (N=538) was used to assess disease-related deviations.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: To estimate normative retinal decline, we used these measurements from N = 56,545 healthy individuals from the UK Biobank... To relate disease-related retinal decline to the normative decline... we then included N = 538 separate individuals from the UK Biobank with a mental disorder
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Georgiadis2024.pdf.md: Methods / Design, setting, and participants, L122-L130

dc_3_healthy_control_number_of_each_norm.detail: All models (macular thickness, RNFL, and GC-IPL) were built using the same healthy control sample from the UK Biobank. The total N is 56,545.

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_model.detail: The healthy control sample has a mean age of 56.26 years (SD 8.13). Detailed stats like median or min/max are not reported in the table or main text.

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_model.detail: The healthy control group consists of 30,971 females (54.77%) and 25,574 males (45.23%).
